items.heading: The Five Routes Below Use
items.text: The five routes below use different regulators and exams. Treat the pay column as a marker, not an offer, and check every row on the official site before you act.

items.heading: The Nursing and Midwifery Council
items.text: The Nursing and Midwifery Council reported 10,961 nurses, midwives and nursing associates trained outside the UK joining its register for the first time in the year to 31 March 2026. That is 9,708 (47%) fewer than the 20,669 the year before.

items.heading: A Nurse Sits the Nclex
items.text: A nurse sits the NCLEX-RN and holds a state licence, then needs an employer to sponsor an EB-3 green card, the category for skilled workers and professionals. That is three filters in a row: the licence, the sponsor and then the queue.

items.heading: The Same Page Says Most
items.text: The same page says most nurse packages cover housing or an allowance, listed at about AED 2,000 to 5,000 a month, so the cash you save can be higher.

items.heading: The Route Is Usually Shorter
items.text: The route is usually shorter than the UK or US routes, but each country has its own exam and rules.
